build_feature_schema: build a tensorflow_datasets Feature proto message with nested features_dict and class_label fields
create_features_dict: create a FeaturesDict proto message containing a map of feature name to Feature definitions
create_image_feature: create an ImageFeature proto message with shape, dtype, encoding_format, and use_colormap fields
create_sequence_feature: create a Sequence proto message wrapping a nested Feature with an optional length field
create_translation_feature: create a TranslationFeature proto message with a list of languages and variable_languages_per_example flag
